name: visual-prompt-architect
description: Art-directed editorial template system with design intelligence, easy/advanced modes, logo harmony, auto-designed shell, Hero, balanced masonry, themed frames, and Before/After layouts.

interface.longDescription: Understands communication goals and reference images, develops a coherent art direction, protects and harmonizes institutional logos, and builds reusable poster, infographic, newsletter, magazine, journal, and one-page templates with editorial shells, Hero sections, balanced masonry panels, and Before/After comparison layouts.
defaultPrompt: Create a professional poster prompt from my requirements and reference images.
Design an infographic prompt using A4 portrait unless I specify otherwise.
Review my poster requirements and build the strongest visual direction before writing the final prompt.
